messages.content: i want to visit my sister tomorrow, but i do not know whether she will be home.
can you ask her whether tomorrow is a good day to visit?
i asked, and she said yes. does that mean i should go to her house?
not for sure. she said the day works, but you still need to know where to meet.
she usually asks me to come to her house.
that gives you a reason to think of her house, but it is still useful to check. she might have a different plan tomorrow.
write a short question about the place.
shall i come to your house, or would you like to meet in another place?
she said the park, near the large tree. what do i know now?
you know the visit is tomorrow and the place is the park near the large tree. you have not given me an hour yet.
i thought tomorrow was a time.
it gives the day. if you need to know when during that day, you can ask for an hour or a part of the day.
ask about morning or afternoon without asking about the place again.
would morning or afternoon work better for you?
she said morning. now tell me the plan without adding an hour.
you will meet your sister tomorrow morning in the park near the large tree.
if i say i am tired, and you tell my brother about it, should you say i am tired too?
if i am talking about you, i should say you are tired or use your name. saying i am tired would make it about me.
what if you are talking to my brother and he does not know who you mean by you?
then i need to make the person clear. i could use your name if you had given it, or explain which person i mean.
do not give me a name. use my sister as an example instead.
if your sister says i am tired, you can tell your brother: my sister is tired.
now she says i need my book. how do i tell him?
my sister needs her book.
why not my book?
because the book in her message is hers. when you tell someone else, her book keeps that meaning. my book would make it yours.
what if i really do mean my own book?
then my book is right. the important part is whose book you are talking about.
give me the two sentences together.
my sister needs her book. i need my book.
does that tell you the color of each book?
no. it gives information about whose books they are, not their color.
the door to the room is closed. is the room empty?
a closed door alone does not tell us whether anyone is inside.
i cannot hear anyone talking.
that still does not tell us for sure. someone could be reading quietly, sleeping, or simply not talking.
so should i say there is someone inside?
no. we do not know that either. both an empty room and a quiet person inside are possible.
what do i know for sure?
you know the door is closed and you cannot hear anyone talking. you do not yet know whether the room is empty.
i opened the door and saw my brother reading. what changes?
now you know your brother is inside. the room is not empty.
can i say he was sleeping before i opened it?
not from what you told me. you saw him reading. you have not said what he was doing before that.
make a short story using only the facts i gave.
the door was closed, and you could not hear anyone talking. you opened it and saw your brother reading inside.
do not change you to i unless i ask for my own voice, right?
right. if you want to tell the story yourself, you can ask me to write it with i.
write a quiet story about a father and daughter looking for a book. they should find it, but do not have them go outside at the end.

a father and his daughter wanted to read together after dinner. the book was not on the shelf where they usually kept it. they looked on the table and by the window. then the daughter remembered reading on the sofa that morning. she went back to the living room and found the book under a pillow. her father sat next to her, and she opened the first page. they read quietly until it was time for bed.
why did she look on the sofa?
she remembered reading there that morning, so it was a useful place to look.
did the father put the book there?
the story does not say that. it only says the daughter found it under a pillow.
can you change the last part so the daughter reads to her father?
her father sat next to her, and she opened the first page. she read to him quietly until it was time for bed.
does that mean he cannot read?
no. someone can listen to another person reading even when they can read themselves.
now give the last part in one sentence.
she sat next to her father and read to him until it was time for bed.
keep that last sentence. what could we call the story?
the book under the pillow.
i put two coins in a container, then one more. my friend says there are two because that was the first number. who is right?
there are three coins if no coins were taken out. you added one to the two already inside.
i take one out and give it to my brother. how many are left inside?
two coins are left inside.
how many coins did my brother have before i gave him one?
you have not said. i know you gave him one, but not how many he already had.
he had four. now how many does he have?
he has five coins now.
did the coin he had before come from my container?
you have not told me where his first four coins came from.
i mean the one i just gave him.
yes. that coin came from your container. you took one out and gave it to him.
why did you give a different answer before?
your first question said the coin he had before. that could mean one of his original coins. your new message makes clear that you mean the coin you gave him.
tell me how many coins are in each place at the end without calling all the coins mine.
there are two coins left in your container, and your brother has five coins.
i have told you there is an animal in the garden. can you tell me what it eats?
not from that alone. different animals need different food. i would need to know more about this animal.
what if i tell you it is small?
small gives its size, but it still does not give enough information about what food it needs.
then do not choose a food for it. ask me one question.
what kind of animal is it?
for this story, i only know it is an animal and it is in the garden. can you write a sentence without adding what it eats?
a small animal is in the garden.
what if i did not want the size in the sentence?
an animal is in the garden.
does taking small out mean the animal got larger?
no. it changes how much information the sentence gives. it does not say the animal changed size.
now say what we know and what we do not know in two short sentences.
we know an animal is in the garden. we do not know what kind it is or what it eats.
could the animal move later?
yes. being in the garden now does not mean it must stay there.
my friend asked for less sugar in her tea. i gave her tea without any sugar. does less always mean no sugar?
no. less can mean you use some sugar, but not as much as before. it does not always mean you leave the sugar out. you could ask how much she would like.
she usually has two small cups of tea. i mean the sugar in each cup, not the number of cups.
then keep the two cups the same and ask about the sugar in each one. less sugar does not have to mean fewer cups.
write that question.
how much sugar would you like in each cup?
she says just a little. can i know how much that is for sure?
not for sure. a little is general. if you need to know how much, you can ask her to show you.
can you explain less and fewer with these same things?
less sugar is about how much sugar. fewer cups is about how many cups.
if she wants one cup instead of two, which word works?
fewer. one cup is fewer than two cups.
and if she wants the same two cups with no sugar?
then she can say two cups of tea without sugar.
now give me a short reply to her first request without choosing how much sugar to use.
okay. how much sugar would you like?
i said my aunt visited today, but i need to change that. she visited yesterday.
your aunt visited yesterday.
i also said she brought a book. did changing the day change what she brought?
no. the new day does not change the book unless you tell me that part was wrong too.
she brought two books, not one.
then the information is that your aunt visited yesterday and brought two books.
should you keep saying one book because i said that first?
no. your new message changes that part. i should use two books now.
what if i say i am not sure whether it was two or three?
then i should keep that part open. i can say she brought books, but you are not sure whether there were two or three.
can you still say yesterday?
yes. you have not changed the day again.
give me the story as i would tell it, with the part i am not sure about made clear.
my aunt visited yesterday and brought some books. i am not sure whether she brought two or three.
now i checked. it was three.
then you can say: my aunt visited yesterday and brought three books.
make a sentence with wait about something i often do.
i wait by the door after school.
now make it about yesterday.
i waited by the door after school yesterday.
what about something happening now?
i am waiting by the door now.
can i write i am waited by the door now?
not for the meaning you want. i am waiting by the door now says that you are doing the waiting.
use my brother instead of i.
my brother is waiting by the door now.
why did am change to is?
with my brother in that sentence, use is. with i, use am.
now turn it into a question i can ask my brother himself.
are you waiting by the door now?
why you instead of my brother?
because you are now talking to him. you is how you ask him about himself.
give just the short yes answer he could give.
yes, i am.
i had a long day. i do not need a plan right now. i just want a quiet conversation.
we can keep it quiet. you do not have to make a plan or explain the whole day.
i sat by the window after work and watched the light change.
that sounds like a calm part of the day. what was it like by the window?
it was warm. i had my tea, and nobody was asking me to do anything.
a little quiet time with warm tea can be welcome after a long day.
please do not turn it into a list of things i should do every night.
okay. we can simply talk about that moment without making it a rule for tomorrow.
my sister called later. i liked hearing her voice, but i was too tired for a long talk.
you can like hearing from her and still want a short talk. those feelings can happen together.
what could i say next time without making it sound like i do not want to hear from her?
it is good to hear your voice. i am tired this evening, so can we have a short talk and speak more another day?
give me a shorter message with the same meaning.
it is good to hear from you. can we talk for a little while now and have a longer talk another day?
thank you. just end with a kind sentence, no question.
i hope you have a quiet evening.
